scenes.say: Reading in dim light will ruin your eyes. Myth, or fact?

scenes.en: Dim light does not cause permanent eye damage.
scenes.ta: இது தவறான நம்பிக்கை. நிரந்தர பாதிப்பு இல்லை
scenes.say: It's a myth. Reading in dim light does not permanently damage your eyes.

scenes.en: Your eyes strain to focus and blink less: tired, dry eyes, headache.
scenes.ta: கண் கடினமாக வேலை செய்யும், சோர்வு வரும்
scenes.say: But it does make them work harder. In low light, your eyes strain to focus, and you blink less. That leads to tired, dry eyes and headaches. The good news: it goes away with rest.

scenes.en: After 40, your eyes need much more light to read comfortably.
scenes.ta: 40 வயதுக்கு பிறகு படிக்க அதிக வெளிச்சம் தேவை
scenes.say: Did you know? As we age, less light reaches the back of the eye. After forty, you may need much more light to read comfortably.

scenes.en: Lamp behind or beside you. No glare. Look far every 20 minutes.
scenes.say: Place a lamp behind or beside you, not in front. Avoid glare on the page. And every twenty minutes, look far away for twenty seconds.

scenes.en: Don't read a bright phone in a dark room. Turn a light on.
scenes.say: Reading your phone in a dark room? Turn on a room light, and lower the screen brightness.
If you still struggle to read, even in good light, you may need glasses. Book an eye test today.
